relation_projection.interpretation: REVIEW_WITH records encode reciprocal explicit comparator mentions only. They do not assert agreement, transfer, causality, or priority.

semantic_assertions.statement: A Shi holdout atomic Claim is exactly one Finding in the structural relation layer.
REVIEW_WITH means reciprocal explicit comparator mention and only nominates a pair for review.
Finding confidence is confidence in the statement as written and can be high for a measured null or limitation.
Finding, comparator, citation, and relation frequencies are not biological priority scores.
This corpus calibration does not recompute endpoint measurements or differential expression.
Atomic structural Claim counts are not directly comparable to higher-order semantic Claim counts.
